front: Khái niệm 'Reported Speech (Indirect Speech)' trong Unit 6: Science and Technology được định nghĩa như thế nào?
back:
Used to communicate what someone else said without quoting their exact words. Typically requires shifting tenses back (backshift), changing pronouns, and updating time/place markers.

💡 Ví dụ: Direct: 'I am reading a tech blog,' Minh said. -> Reported: Minh said that he was reading a tech blog.
🌱 Bản chất: Allows the reporting speaker to integrate another person's statement smoothly into the current narrative context.

front: Phát biểu quy tắc / định lí: 'Tense shift rule in Reported Speech'?
back:
When the reporting verb is in the past (said, told), shift the verb in the quote one tense back: Present Simple -> Past Simple; Present Continuous -> Past Continuous; Will -> Would; Can -> Could.

📝 Ví dụ: 'We will test the robot tomorrow' -> They said that they would test the robot the following day.
🔑 Ý nghĩa: Reflects the temporal distance between the moment of original utterance and the moment of reporting.

front: Phương pháp giải bài toán: 'Change into reported speech: 'Lan said: "My father works as a software engineer at a tech company."''?
back:
Các bước giải chi tiết:
Step 1: Change pronoun: 'My father' becomes 'Her father'.
Step 2: Shift tense: Present Simple 'works' becomes Past Simple 'worked'.
Step 3: Combine with reporting clause: 'Lan said that her father worked as a software engineer at a tech company.'

👉 Kết luận: Lan said that her father worked as a software engineer at a tech company.

front: Bẫy sai lầm cần tránh: Forgetting to change time words: keeping 'tomorrow' instead of 'the next day / the following day'.?
back:
❌ Lỗi sai: Forgetting to change time words: keeping 'tomorrow' instead of 'the next day / the following day'.

💡 Nguyên nhân & Khắc phục: Time markers are anchored to the original moment of speaking; when reported later, they must be adjusted relative to the present.
